notes.title: 5/2 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Game Update

1. Character Level cap has been raised to 65, Experience required to Upgrade from levels 59 to 60 has been reduced.
2. New Class "Berserker" is now available, Class items will drop it from "Sapphire Keep (5 Players)".

3. The Dungeon "Sapphire Keep (Solo/5 Players)" is now open.A). After completing the Main Task "Lv65. Into the Breach," Player can enter the Dungeon from the entrance in "Sky City Constellacia" (720, 1322).B). There is a chance to obtain the Berserker job change item "Berserker's Awakening" when clearing the Dungeon "(Party) Sapphire Keep."

5. Added "Aurora Sanctum: Hall of Trials" Dungeon
A). After completing the prerequisite Task "Lv45. Eye'll Be Seeing You," Guide Task "Lv45. Lv45. Sanctum Sanctorum" will automatically be triggered at Level 45.
B). After reaching Level 45, players can enter the Dungeon "Aurora Sanctum: Hall of Trials (Solo/5 Players)" at the Central Continent (730, 372).

6. "Rose, Rose, I Love You~" event has started!
Start from "5/2 (Thu) after maintenance to 5/9 (Thu) before maintenance." During the event, spend a specified amount of points at the AP shop to receive corresponding rewards Click Here for more detail


7. The "Unspoken Love" event begins,
Start from "5/2 (Thu) after maintenance ~ 5/30 (Thu) before maintenance."
Characters reach Level 20 During the time of the event will automatically trigger the Task "Lv20. Unspoken Love."
Upon completion, players can undertake Mother's Day series Tasks, and by collecting enough "Sincere Heart," Can Redeem Facial Accessory Appearances or event titles!

8. The Royal City of Arcadia NPC "Exotic Merchant Sebastian" Now will selling some level 60 equipment recipes.

9. The inquiry window for acquiring more powerful equipment has added the "Do Not Show Again Today" option.

10. Fixed the issue where the "Emilia" Senshi Task achievement did not appear.

11. Remove Lil' Mo and Masquerade Event
※Unused treasure map rewards will be removed after the maintenance on 5/9 (Thu).

Further detailed Mall & Puzzle of this week, please visit official Website

notes.title: 4/18 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Game Update

notes.title: 3/28 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Special Update
Next week coincides with consecutive holidays, Maintenance on 4/4 (Thursday) will be moved up to 4/3 (Wednesday), Please take note.

Game Update

1. New (Solo) Desert Wasteland
A) After completing the prerequisite task "Lv40. Turn That Frown Upside Down, "Lv40. Desert Wasteland" will be automatically triggered at Lv.40 in the "The Royal City of Arcadia."
B) After completing the guide task, you can enter the Dungeon "(Solo) Desert Wasteland" at The Royal City of Arcadia (219, 397).

2. New Senshi Task.Players can assign Senshi to the Terracottage through "Terracottage Management," and upon entering the Terracottage, can accept the Task from the Senshi.
A) A single account can accept up to 5 Tasks per day.
B) Upon completing a Task, players will receive 20 points of Senshi bond value.

3. The 'Unknown Dimension' event has Return,Star from after the maintenance on 3/28 (Thu) to before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thu). Once a character reaches Level 30 during the event period, Can head to The Royal City of Arcadia (X361, Y348) to find the NPC Unknown Dimension. By following the Dialogue prompts and submitting the corresponding items, players will receive a token of appreciation from Him, with a chance to earn a special event title!
※Players can reset the Unknown's receipt status by submitting 20 gold."

4. Added the "Auto-Skip Dungeon Cutscenes" featurePlayers now can select it via "System Settings" > "Gameplay" > "Display Settings".
※This function is limited to skipping Dungeon cutscenes that have been viewed before.
※The scope of application is mainly for those that could previously be skipped with the ESC key.

5. The Guild has added a new NPC, " Rochi,"Who can Redeem the high-times Guild Community Chest with either 10 or 20 Chests.
※For example: Use 10 Guild Community Chests to Redeem 1 Guild Community Chest (10x Rewards), which allows you to receive 10 times the rewards at once when opened on the Guild Airship.

6. Fixed the issue where setting the hotkey to "~" would revert to default after maintenance.

7. Adjusted the issue where CRIT rate, CRIT taken rate, CRIT damage, and damage taken from CRITs against specific types of targets were abnormal.

8. Fixed an issue where casting abilities in rapid succession with high attack speed could cause the character to get stuck.

9. Adjust the stackable number of "Chest" and "Guild Community Chest" to 100.※Magic Sealed Chestt has not been adjusted yet.

10. Next week, Will unlock the New Level cap, new scenes, and the Rogue Class. Players, please look forward to it. Start From this week's maintenance until to maintenance of next week, the experience gained from defeating monsters will increase by 50%!

Further detailed Mall & update schedule of this week, please visit official Website

notes.title: 03/21 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Game Update
1.New "(Solo) Furval's Fantasia" Dungeon added

 1. After completing the prerequisite Task "Lv30. Once in a Blue Moon" a Guide Task "Lv30. Furvalicious" will automatically be triggered at Lv.30 in the scene "The Royal City of Arcadia."
 2. After completing the Guide Task, you can enter the "(Solo) Furval's Fantasia" Dungeon at The Royal City of Arcadia (219, 397).


2. New Battlefield "Battlefield: Golden Desert"

 1. Character Level Requirement: Players LV.50 and above
 2. Available Time: Daily from 20:00 to 20:30.
 2. Players can attempt to capture a "Neutral/Enemy" stronghold when they approach it, and defend a "Friendly" stronghold when they are near it. Players defending a stronghold will resist the progress of other players attempting to capture it.
 3. Strongholds occupied by either the Red or Blue faction will distribute different amounts of "Gold Nuggets" to players of the respective faction at regular intervals, depending on the players' "Level" in "Battlefield: Golden Desert".
※ "Level" is affected by the player's "Battlefield Points", which can be earned by "killing enemies" and "capturing strongholds".
 4. In addition to the above methods for earning "Battlefield Points", players can also collect "Gold Relics" in "Battlefield: Golden Desert" and submit them to their faction's  military officer to gain a certain amount of points.


3. The "Scattered Stars of the World" event has Start
Start From maintenance on 3/21 (Thu) to before the maintenance on 4/3 (Thu). Players have a chance to obtain a "Mysterious Star" when they harvest items of orange quality or higher while fishing, gathering, or mining. These stars can be taken to the The Royal City of Arcadia (373,288), Consume 3 "Mysterious Stars" can be exchanged with the Butler Alfred for an event-exclusive blessing. Players can also exchange in-game currency for a limited title.

4.Blossom Sweetheart's Gift' event has started
Start from '3/21 (Thu) after maintenance to 3/28 (Thu) before maintenance'. During the event, spend the specified amount of points at the AP shop to receive corresponding rewards, detailed content Please refer to Official Website

5.Adjustments to Dungeon-related mechanics:

 A. Reduce the daily Dungeon attempts, "Escort Meow Meow" from 5 times to 1 time, and the number of rewards per completion from 1 to 5.
 B. Reduce the Main Dungeon (Solo/5 Players) attempts from 5 times to 2 times, the number of drops from monsters to 2 times, the Solo Boss drops to 5 times, and the 5 Players Boss drops to 7 times.
 C. In response to the reduction in attempts, the Dungeon monsters, drop rates, and Gold amounts have been increased to approximately 2.5x

※ Players who have completed Dungeons before maintenance may see their attempt counts appear as 3/2, 4/2, 5/2, etc., after maintenance. This is normal and will return to normal after the daily reset.

6. Adjust the mechanics of the Furval Arena.

7. Adjust the production system materials and the stack limit of Treasure Chest Candy to 999.

8. Adjust the stack limit of -Starstone Fragment to 1000.

9. Adjust the difficulty of the anti-cheat captcha recognition once again.

10.Removing "Metarealm hunt" & "Adventurer's Gold Bonus" Event

11. Increase the number of lines for the chat channel.

12. Remove the sound effects when Mikka and Catherine move.

13. Remove the time Restrictions on certain limited-time items.

notes.title: Astral-Tale Global Open Beta Release Date!!!
notes.notes:
Dear players of Astral Tale,

🌟 We extend our heartfelt gratitude for your enthusiasm and anticipation for "Astral Tale." We are delighted to announce that the official global service commencement date is confirmed for January 10, 2024 (Wednesday)! 🚀
This marks an exhilarating moment, and we can't wait to embark on this fantastical adventure with you in the world of Astral. As we begin the new year, we sincerely invite you to join us on this grand journey into uncharted territories.

🎮 On the day of the official service launch, you will immerse yourself in the game's captivating story-line and diverse gameplay. We anticipating the creation of beautiful memories together in the realm of Astral Tale.
